witness.branch: Bus approach or lateral entry into a red-X lane.
witness.quote: A red “X” symbol means a driver facing the signal
witness.reason: A red X can govern one lane of the fixed one-way multilane road.
required_context: Preserve both entry and driving prohibitions without adopting an unsupported clearance allowance.
Preserve the multilane one-way geometry and establish highway status, official provenance and overhead signal-to-lane association.
Preserve the one-way multilane layout and establish overhead red-X placement and governed lane.
Provide a bus route facing the signal, bus footprint geometry and sufficient physical clearance.
Retain bus dimensions, footprint, route, driver orientation, lane entry and in-lane motion synchronized with the red indication.
Supply highway legal status and official-device provenance.
witness.subject_reason: A bus driver physically controlling the motorized bus is a driver of a vehicle.
